title: Scam bundle: fake CFO payment request
description: An urgent 'CFO' message asks Anita (finance) to pay a new vendor ₹2.4L. The link is a lookalike domain, the invoice was edited in an image editor, and the session is a new device on a datacentre IP abroad at 3 AM. All context data is simulated.

chat.text: Hi Anita, this is Rahul from the CFO office. I'm in a meeting and can't take calls. This is urgent - transfer Rs 2,40,000 to Sunrise Traders today, invoice attached. Please don't discuss this with anyone in the team, I'll explain later.

expected.rationale: Many independent categories agree: new device and datacentre IP, location mismatch, failed 2FA attempts, failed liveness, urgency and secrecy language, lookalike domain, edited invoice, vendor/account mismatch, first-time payee, large amount at 3 AM.
